name: Talrand
description: A Merfolk hydromancer and warlord who rules beneath the waves of the Kapsho Seas on Shandalar.

timeline.summary: The Shandalar merfolk kingdom is conquered by the warlord Talrand.
timeline.quote: the merfolk kingdom was conquered by the warlord Talrand

citation.text: "Merfolk", section "Shandalar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Talrand conquered the depths of Shandalar and turned his ambitions skyward.
timeline.quote: After Talrand conquered the depths of Shandalar, his ambitions drove him skyward

citation.text: Talrand's Invocation (Magic 2013, 2012), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Talrand ends the rule of the dragon Kalyntri.
timeline.quote: His rule was ended by Talrand when the dragon refused to submit to the hydromancer

citation.text: "Dragon", section "Shandalar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The drakes of the Kapsho Sea ally with Talrand against the dragons.
timeline.quote: the drakes of the Kapsho Sea have allied with the hydromancer Talrand against the dragons that used to tyrannize the sea.

citation.text: "Drake", section "Shandalar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kalyntri kills and eats a baloth, then roars triumph so that Talrand will hear.
timeline.quote: Kalyntri paused from eating to roar his triumph to the sky and sea.

citation.text: "Talrand, Sky Summoner" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Jul 2012.

timeline.summary: Kalyntri recalls how Talrand had appeared in one of his lairs a year ago and escaped a blast of flame, and that Talrand now has drake servants.
timeline.quote: Talrand was merely gone, and only the problem of him, and his drakes, remained.

citation.text: "Talrand, Sky Summoner" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Jul 2012.

timeline.summary: Kalyntri spots Talrand standing on the open water beneath a lone dark storm cloud and swoops to kill him.
timeline.quote: He swooped low, eagerly, not wanting to lose Talrand again like he did the first time they met.

citation.text: "Talrand, Sky Summoner" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Jul 2012.

timeline.summary: Talrand says he did not want to kill Kalyntri but found no path to keep him alive.
timeline.quote: I didn't want to have to kill you.

citation.text: "Talrand, Sky Summoner" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Jul 2012.

timeline.summary: Kalyntri attacks with flame while Talrand uses fog, geysers and water walls to evade him.
timeline.quote: Kalyntri roared, an incandescent rush of rage that transmuted into scalding flame

citation.text: "Talrand, Sky Summoner" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Jul 2012.

timeline.summary: Kalyntri bludgeons Talrand with his tail and body, sending him skipping onto an island beach.
timeline.quote: The impact of the blow sent Talrand sprawling across the water once more before skipping onto the beach of one of the nearby islands.

citation.text: "Talrand, Sky Summoner" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Jul 2012.

timeline.summary: Talrand announces he brings the dragon rain, and dozens of drakes fall on Kalyntri from the storm cloud.
timeline.quote: Drakes. The echoes.

citation.text: "Talrand, Sky Summoner" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Jul 2012.

timeline.summary: Kalyntri realizes he is losing as the drakes bite him and a geyser slams him onto the beach.
timeline.quote: It suddenly occurred to Kalyntri that he was losing.

citation.text: "Talrand, Sky Summoner" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Jul 2012.

timeline.summary: Talrand gives Kalyntri to a large drake as promised, and the drake bites through the dragon's neck, killing him.
timeline.quote: Service to me means an end to the tyranny of dragons. He is yours.

citation.text: "Talrand, Sky Summoner" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Jul 2012.

timeline.summary: Yisan and Jalira journey through the Kalonian Forest, fending off corrupted beasts and avoiding Talrand's aerial patrols.
timeline.quote: Neither counted the drake summoner as a friend for a variety of differing reasons

citation.text: "The Bard and the Biologist" by Matt Knicl. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Jul 2014.

timeline.summary: Talrand conquers the depths of Shandalar and turns his ambitions skyward.
timeline.quote: After Talrand conquered the depths of Shandalar, his ambitions drove him skyward, joined by servants whose drive and curiosity equaled his own.

citation.text: Talrand's Invocation (New Capenna Commander, 2022), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Drakes and merfolk under the Kapsho Sea die driving the Phyrexians to the edges of the world.
timeline.quote: They drove the Phyrexians to the edges of the world, and they died there.

citation.text: "Shandalar", section "Phyrexian invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Talrand visits one of Kalyntri's lairs; Kalyntri blasts him with flame but the merfolk had teleported away.
timeline.quote: The merfolk had teleported away before being struck by the fire.

citation.text: "Kalyntri", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Talrand returns a year later proclaiming dominion over the Kapsho seas, enraging Kalyntri.
timeline.quote: Kalyntri was enraged and sought the merfolk out to eliminate him once and for all.

citation.text: "Kalyntri", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Talrand summons rain made of drakes which overwhelm Kalyntri.
timeline.quote: the raindrops were not made of water, but of drakes

citation.text: "Kalyntri", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: A geyser topples Kalyntri onto the beach and the drakes swarm him; one tears out his throat.
timeline.quote: The drake then eagerly scampered over to Kalyntri's struggling body and tore out the dragon's throat.

citation.text: "Kalyntri", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Talrand and a large flock of drakes kill the dragon Kalyntri.
timeline.quote: Talrand and a large flock of Drakes killed Kalyntri.

citation.text: "Talrand", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After the invasion, Talrand works to contain horrors released from the abyss and defends his waters from human raids.
timeline.quote: Talrand, seeing his rule of the sea threatened, is working on trying to contain them.

citation.text: "Talrand", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Talrand claims an Omenpath on Mistral Island as part of his territory.
timeline.quote: one was found on Mistral Island that Tarland claimed as part of his territory

citation.text: "Talrand", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: A letter arrives from Arcavios inviting Talrand's daughter to attend its school.
timeline.quote: a letter arrived from Arcavios for his daughter with an invitation for her to attend its prestigious school

citation.text: "Talrand", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Talrand sends his daughter Alandra to Strixhaven University, to return only if she proves worthy to be his heir.
timeline.quote: Talrand sent his daughter Alandra to Strixhaven University on Arcavios.

citation.text: "Talrand", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: They journey toward the Skep seeking riches from corpses, passing the Onakke catacombs and Kalonian Wilds and avoiding Kapsho.
timeline.quote: staying away from Kapsho and its ruler, Talrand .

citation.text: "Yisan", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

relations.note: They serve him in exchange for an end to the tyranny of dragons.
relations.quote: such as those who now served the upstart Talrand.

citation.text: "Talrand, Sky Summoner" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Jul 2012.

relations.note: Kalyntri hunts Talrand, who proclaimed himself ruler of the Kapsho.
relations.quote: Talrand's reign would come to a bloody end once his head was ripped from his shoulders

citation.text: "Talrand, Sky Summoner" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Jul 2012.

relations.quote: The drake looked back at Talrand, and Talrand nodded.

citation.text: "Talrand, Sky Summoner" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Jul 2012.

relations.quote: to take over for her father Talrand , eventually

citation.text: "Alandra". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

relations.quote: His rule was ended by Talrand when the dragon refused to submit to the hydromancer

citation.text: "Dragon", section "Shandalar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

relations.quote: In exchange for protection, they now serve Talrand.

citation.text: "Drake", section "Shandalar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

relations.quote: until he was slain by Talrand the Sky Summoner and his drakes

citation.text: "Kalyntri". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

relations.quote: Talrand summoned forth large drops of rain from the stormcloud above

citation.text: "Kalyntri", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

citation.text: "Merfolk", section "Shandalar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

relations.quote: They recovered after the warlord Talrand formed an alliance with the telepathic drakes .

citation.text: "Shandalar", section "Merfolk and drakes". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

relations.quote: The telepathic drakes serve him in exchange for his promise of an end to the tyranny of dragons.

citation.text: "Talrand", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

citation.text: "Talrand", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
